name: Triplane Encoder for Single-Image Portrait View Synthesis
definition: A feedforward encoder pipeline that maps an unposed RGB image directly to a canonical triplane 3D representation, avoiding expensive GAN inversion and test-time optimization.
summary: The Triplane Encoder is a feed-forward pipeline that maps a single unposed RGB image directly to a canonical triplane representation for real-time portrait view synthesis, avoiding expensive GAN inversion or test-time optimization.
